people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.

translations.web: but don’t prophesy again any more at Bethel; for it is the king’s sanctuary, and it is a royal house!”
translations.bsb: But never prophesy at Bethel again, because it is the sanctuary of the king and the temple of the kingdom.”
translations.kjv: But prophesy not again any more at Bethel: for it is the king's chapel, and it is the king's court.
translations.asv: but prophesy not again any more at Beth-el; for it is the king's sanctuary, and it is a royal house.
